 Fill \(\partial_t\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}\) for all six symmetric components.

Detailed Description

RHS for the conformal metric \(\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}\).

Evaluates

\[\partial_t\tilde{\gamma}_{ij} = -2\alpha\tilde{A}_{ij} + \mathcal{L}_\beta \tilde{\gamma}_{ij} - \tfrac{2}{3}\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}\partial_k\beta^k + \mathcal{D}_6[\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}]. \]

Lie derivatives expand into \(\tilde{\gamma}_{ik}\partial_j\beta^k + \tilde{\gamma}_{jk}\partial_i\beta^k\) plus the advection term \(\beta^k\partial_k\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}\).
